skill.description: Process PDFs with Python and command-line workflows for text extraction, table extraction, merging, splitting, OCR, PDF generation, and form filling.

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, JavaScript template strings, comments, or documentation URLs. The only confirmed issues are expected helper-script writes to caller-supplied output paths, which can overwrite local files if used carelessly. No evidence of hidden network access, credential access, prompt injection, or data exfiltration was found.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts can overwrite caller-supplied output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Refuse to overwrite existing files unless a clear force option is provided, and document that outputs should stay inside a dedicated working directory.

remediation.issue: Intermediate form files may contain sensitive user data.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to store generated JSON, PNG, and PDF outputs in a private workspace and remove temporary files after review.

remediation.issue: Documentation examples use fixed output filenames.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer unique destination filenames in examples to reduce accidental overwrites during repeated runs.

content.user_title: Automate PDF Processing and Form Filling
content.value_statement: PDF work often needs reliable extraction, conversion, and form handling. This skill provides guided workflows and helper scripts for common document tasks.
actual_capabilities: Read PDF page counts, metadata, and text with pypdf and pdfplumber.
Extract tables from PDF pages and prepare structured data with pandas examples.
Create new PDFs and reports with ReportLab examples.
Merge, split, rotate, watermark, crop, and encrypt PDF files.
Identify fillable form fields and validate field values before writing output PDFs.
Convert PDF pages to PNG images and add text annotations for non-fillable forms.
limitations: Requires local Python libraries and tools such as pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab, pdf2image, and Poppler.
OCR and image conversion quality depends on the source scan and installed system dependencies.
Non-fillable forms require manual visual validation of field positions and bounding boxes.
Helper scripts write local output files and should be run only with trusted paths.

use_cases.title: Prepare Document Packets
use_cases.description: Merge, split, rotate, and watermark PDFs for repeatable document assembly workflows.

use_cases.title: Complete PDF Forms
use_cases.description: Inspect form fields, validate entries, and generate filled PDFs from provided user data.

use_cases.title: Extract Report Data
use_cases.description: Pull text and tables from PDF reports for review, cleanup, and downstream analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Extract PDF Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the text from this PDF, keep page order, and summarize any pages with missing or unreadable text.

prompt_templates.title: Merge Selected Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge these PDFs in the listed order, rotate any sideways pages, and save a single final PDF with a clear filename.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a Form PDF
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this PDF has fillable fields, map each field to the provided data, validate values, and create a completed copy.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Batch Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a batch process for this folder of PDFs that extracts text, captures tables, logs failures, and avoids overwriting outputs.

output_examples.input: A scanned invoice PDF needs searchable text and a page summary.
output_examples.output: The result includes extracted text by page, notes about low-confidence OCR areas, and a short invoice summary.

output_examples.input: Three PDFs need to be merged, with one page rotated before delivery.
output_examples.output: The result is a single combined PDF with the requested page order and corrected orientation.

output_examples.input: A non-fillable application form needs name, address, date, and checkbox entries.
output_examples.output: The result includes validation images for field placement and a filled PDF with text annotations.

best_practices: Work in a dedicated folder so generated PDFs, images, and JSON files are easy to review.
Inspect output PDFs visually before sharing forms, contracts, or official documents.
Use unique output filenames to avoid overwriting source files or previous results.
anti_patterns: Do not process sensitive PDFs in shared folders without access controls.
Do not assume scanned PDFs have extractable text without OCR validation.
Do not skip bounding box validation when filling non-fillable forms.

faq.question: Can this skill fill PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports fillable fields and non-fillable forms that need text annotations.

faq.question: Does it support scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, but scanned PDFs need OCR or image conversion before reliable text extraction.

faq.question: Can it extract tables?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide includes pdfplumber and pandas workflows for extracting and shaping table data.

faq.question: Will it edit the original PDF?
faq.answer: The examples and scripts generally write new output files. Users should still choose safe output paths.

faq.question: What dependencies are needed?
faq.answer: Common workflows use pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab, pdf2image, Pillow, pandas, Poppler, and optional OCR tools.

faq.question: Is manual review still needed?
faq.answer: Yes. Forms, OCR results, and annotation placement should be checked before final use.
